question: What claim is being made about poison entering the body even under the condition of being bitten by great serpents?
premises: It does not enter the body.
This holds even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
inference: Poison is claimed not to enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
uncertainties: The reason for this immunity is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if bitten by great serpents.
